recipe.description: Lia Merrow original feminine-presenting art direction: broad cheek and forehead volume, soft heart-shaped taper into a compact defined chin, modest upward nose-tip transition, distinct mouth width and sloping lid corners. Neck spreads into her broad service-shirt shoulders. Upstream graphical parameter labels do not establish age, ethnicity, gender identity, biography or palette.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
